dedupe: One confirmed_signup per unique provider confirmation event; no client-only confirmation. If provider events unavailable: event status UNKNOWN, not 0 and not true.
privacy: Never expose email, name, source-IP, confirmation URL tokens, raw individual subscription history in public GitHub or reports.
